description:
The Addison 7 Drawer Dresser has seven dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides for clothing, bedding, and nursery essentials, in a solid hardwood frame.

It measures 60 inches wide, 35 inches high, and 21 inches deep, and it coordinates with the complete Addison collection.
title: Addison 7 Drawer Dresser
